name: Banh beo
summary: Bánh bèo here is a square rice-flour cake with pork and wood ear. Cổng thông tin điện tử thành phố Hải Phòng, on 23 December 2012, adds fried shallot, pieces of banana leaf, and a dip of fish sauce with chili powder and pepper. Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng, on 24 July 2023, names it with giá bể and bì bò at the afternoon markets.
origin: Hai Phong. The 23 December 2012 city portal and the 24 July 2023 tourism portal.
howToEat: The 2012 account says cut the squares, spear them, and dip. It puts the cake in the late afternoon, after work, and in winter.
A price was not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The 2012 account calls the start of Lê Đại Hành phố bánh bèo. The 24 July 2023 map names chợ Cát Bi, chợ Cố Đạo, chợ Chu Văn An, and chợ An Dương. Both stay. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh beo — Hai Phong’s square rice cake
seoDescription: Rice flour, pork, and wood ear, cut in squares. Lê Đại Hành on one account, the afternoon markets on another. A price is Check on arrival.
